name: Storyteller Nexus
description: Runs procedurally seeded, branching stories from templates: Seven keeps the structure (acts, rolled scenarios, what's true about the world), the model writes the prose. It rolls from your repos (in Data); story templates and POIs are its own kinds, and a library folder of JSON files can add more. Story runs are kept in the vault.

settings.name: libraryFolder
settings.label: Library folder
settings.description: Optional. Holds templates/, repos/ and pois/ as JSON you edit by hand (not encrypted); they're used alongside the ones in Data. Story runs found in its stories/ folder are copied into the vault once.

kinds.label: Story template
kinds.description: the acts, branches and calls to action a story run follows

kinds.label: Point of interest
kinds.description: a place stories can draw on

kinds.label: Branching story
kinds.description: a finished story in passages, where the reader's choices lead to other passages
